6.text: Broadcom reported Q3 fiscal 2026 EPS of $3.32, beating estimates, on revenue up 85.5% to $29.59 billion, with AI semiconductor revenue up 221% to $16.7 billion and guidance of $21.7 billion. Articles also note China fell from 32% to 17% of sales since 2023 amid a Beijing switch review.

7.text: Marvell shares have surged over 200% in 2026 on AI data-center demand, with Q2 sales up 37% and raised guidance through fiscal 2028, plus a new Google deal. Valuation is stretched at roughly 80–91 times earnings, and one September report linked AI-stock declines to OpenAI. Broadcom appears only as a comparison point Marvell has outperformed.

9.text: Broadcom is raising $60 billion in debt—a $42 billion senior-secured tranche and an $18 billion junior tranche led by Blackstone—to fund AI chip purchases by Anthropic and other customers. Broadcom stock and TSMC shares rose on the news.

8.text: Broadcom's custom AI chip business is projected to reach $58B revenue in fiscal 2026 and $230B by 2028, with analysts ranking it a top AI pick alongside Nvidia and TSMC. Articles also note its 221% AI revenue growth, 15-year dividend streak, and competition with Micron and TSMC.

11.text: Hybrid photonic integrated circuit market projected to grow from $2.45B (2025) to $6.82B (2035), driven by data centers, 5G, and LiDAR. IT BFSI market to grow from $187.95B (2025) to $359.2B (2030) on cloud, AI, and cybersecurity spending. Neither mentions Broadcom.
